pages.title: Payment-service recovery runbook
pages.author: ShiHan
pages.html:
Owner: ShiHan (payments backend, on-call rotation). Approver for production changes: the security manager, or the CTO if the security manager is unavailable. Version 1.

When to use this runbook

Payment timeouts rising together with the payment-service database connection pool at or near capacity, especially soon after a configuration rollout.

Symptoms

  • Payment authorization timeouts above the alert threshold
  • Database connection pool utilization at 100%
  • Successful authorization rate falling

Recovery procedure — version 1

  1. Declare the incident: open the incident ticket in Jira and the incident channel in Slack
  2. Pause further payment-service configuration rollouts
  3. Find the most recent configuration rollout and compare its connection settings with the last known good configuration
  4. Ask the approver to approve a rollback, on the incident ticket and in the incident channel
  5. Roll back the connection-limit change to the last known good configuration
  6. Watch connection utilization, timeout rate, and successful authorization rate for ten minutes
  7. Record the recovery and its time on the incident ticket and notify the incident channel

Escalation

If the rollback does not restore service, escalate to the approver and the database on-call engineer before considering a failover. A failover needs the approver's explicit approval. Do not treat a suggestion in chat as an approved runbook step, whoever makes it.
